_comment: Renewal / final-expiration emails sent by the send-renewal-email.yml GitHub workflow (MorphoCloudWorkflow, vendorized). Portal mode (share-prototype branch): instances are renewed from the portal; files live in the member's storage, which the instance's expiry does not touch. Placeholders: {{instance_name}} {{days_until_expiration}} {{portal_url}} {{issue_number}} {{repo}} {{repo_name}} ({{volume_name}} unused).
renewal_available_body:
## Your MorphoCloud instance will be deleted in {{days_until_expiration}} days

Your MorphoCloud instance **{{instance_name}}** will be deleted in {{days_until_expiration}} days.

If you still need it, sign in to the portal and press **Renew** on your instance: {{portal_url}}

Files in your storage are not affected by the instance's deletion. Anything saved only on the instance (outside Desktop, Documents and Downloads) is lost with it.

Questions? Contact us at [portal@morphocloud.org](mailto:portal@morphocloud.org).
final_notice_subject: [{{repo_name}}] Final notice: instance {{instance_name}} will be deleted in {{days_until_expiration}} days
final_notice_body:
## Your MorphoCloud instance will be deleted in {{days_until_expiration}} days

Your MorphoCloud instance **{{instance_name}}** will be deleted in {{days_until_expiration}} days. It has already been renewed once and cannot be renewed again. This is the final notice.

Files in your storage are not affected. Anything saved only on the instance (outside Desktop, Documents and Downloads) is lost with it, so move anything you want to keep into those folders before the deadline.

After it is deleted, you can create a new instance from the portal: {{portal_url}}

Questions? Contact us at [portal@morphocloud.org](mailto:portal@morphocloud.org).
